item.text:
I can’t determine the dose without the medicine/order details. Please upload the prescription or label, or provide:

- Medicine name and strength/concentration
- Prescribed dose or indication
- Patient’s age and weight
- Route and relevant kidney/liver function

If a dose may already have been given incorrectly, contact the prescriber/pharmacist immediately; in Australia, call the Poisons Information Centre on **13 11 26**.
